notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics vendor building conversational insights & embeddings for product and support flows. Started with Hosted API PoC late 2025 (internal protos) -> moved to dedicated evaluation due to steady QPS and desire for cost predictability. Cost-sensitive but needs predictable low tail latency. Key asks: committed throughput tiers with burst headroom, transparent overage math (token vs unit), ramp schedule over 12 months, and on‑demand model fallback to cheaper open models for non‑critical traffic.

Proof-of-Concept: small pilot ran Jan–Feb 2026 (support-agent + doc-search). Results: latency 95p ~120ms with Redwood hosted on region-us-west; cost ~0.012/token (hosted) for high-quality model; embedding clustering stable. POC feedback: "service stable, responses match quality bar but cost is the blocker."

Negotiation status: Pricing discussion focused on Dedicated commit levels. We recommended: 100k tokens/min commit with 2x burst for 3 months while they ramp. QuantBridge counter: wants 50k commit + 3x burst, lower overage rate, and a staged ramp (50% month1, 75% month2, 100% month3). They asked for a 6-month price protection clause.

Security/compliance: Need SAML SSO + SCIM integration (SE working on test IdP). SOC2 report requested; we shared Redwood SOC2 binder (drive link above). Data residency: prefer US-only. KMS integration required for keys at rest. Legal raised standard CLIN and audit log retention 13 months.

Operational notes: SE doing load test week of 2026-03-15 to validate autoscale/burst behavior. They want explicit max tail latency SLO (p95 < 250ms) and a fallback routing policy to cheaper 8-bit quantized open model when latency or capacity exceeds threshold. Discussed Intelligent batching suggestions from Redwood Optimize to reduce unit cost on embeddings.

Stakeholder quotes: "We like Redwood's transparent perf numbers and the routing flexibility — but CFO needs to see deterministic commit math before sign." — Head of Platform.

Next tacticals: send Dedicated commitment spreadsheet with three proposal options (Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive), include overage slab examples and sample monthly invoices; schedule procurement+finance call for 2026-03-18.
